desc: 双片可重叠适配多车型，隔热防晒降温，折叠收纳附袋好存放
name: 定制贴合前挡遮阳档款

shots.intent: 一屏说清形态与效果：产品在上装车在下
从焦虑到安心：高温老化闷热三格落到涂层原理图
装得上贴得好的实证：POV 实拍加重叠调节图解
全尺寸系列可批量：折叠对在上车型在下加尺码标签
结构差异点海报化：后视镜开槽特写压前景
一次交代材质贴合与收纳：标注线加三格 inset
品类气场：赛道质感建立定制高端印象
信任闭环：质保服务检测四枚通用图标徽章

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for hero and variant; light blue-gray gradient panel #C7D7ED to #E9F0F8 for pain-and-solution frames; light gray-white diagonal texture #F3F4F6 for spec frames; dark desert or track environments only for structure posters
style.direction: custom-fit auto accessory suite: directory-white product truth, pain-collage to diagram persuasion, dusk poster structure highlights, navy-orange claim system
style.iconSystem: round certification-style badges, dimension lines with dot terminals, thermometer and glow diagram for heat, circular magnifier insets, size-pill labels
style.lightingSystem: softbox frontal or top light with no hard shadows for product; backlight daylight through the windshield for cabin shots; low-angle dusk key with rim light for posters
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: custom-fit windshield sunshade campaign. Clean white-studio hero with the flat-lay shade stacked above a fitted generic sedan; directory-style variant frames pair the folded shade with each vehicle class and a navy size pill; a three-tile real-life pain collage (heat, aging interior, sweating cabin) resolves into a coated-fabric heat-refraction diagram on a light blue panel #C7D7ED to #E9F0F8; dark desert-dusk posters highlight structural cutouts with rim light; navy #1F3D6D pill banners with orange #F5A11C keyword highlights carry every size and material claim, all performance numbers from verified facts. Softbox product light, windshield backlight in cabins, low dusk key in posters; matte polyester faces #EDEFF0 and #26292D, orange locked on navy, no third-party badges or vehicle logos.
noDrift: product geometry fixed to its fold states
no fabricated patents, certifications or lab marks
no unauthorized vehicle brand badges or recognizable plates
brand accents locked to orange on navy
background never becomes a saturated gradient
style.presentationRules: hero stacks flat-lay above fitted car; variant frames always pair the folded shade above with the fitted vehicle below plus a size label; pain frames use three real-life tiles resolving into one diagram; performance numbers shown only when verified
style.surfaceSystem: matte reflective polyester white face #EDEFF0 and black coated face #26292D with bright black binding; matte environments only - asphalt, sand, dashboard - never mirror tables
style.temperature: neutral-cool on white grounds; warm daylight allowed in pain photos; dusk warmth confined to structure posters
style.typography: heavy italic condensed uppercase headlines; navy pill banners carry claims with orange keyword highlight blocks; white type on navy bands
